test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The theme of International Women’s Day 2022 issued by the United Nations was ________.

options.text: Think Equal, Build Smart, Innovate for Change
An Equal World is an Enabled World
Gender Equality Today for a Sustainable Tomorrow
Women in Leadership: Achieving an Equal Future in a COVID-19 World

solution:
The correct answer is __**Gender Equality Today for a Sustainable Tomorrow.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The theme for International Women's Day 2022 (IWD 2022) is** "Gender equality today for a sustainable tomorrow."**
 
• This theme recognises the **contribution of women and girls** around the world, who are **taking the initiative to combat climate change **and help future generations adapt, mitigate, and respond.
 
• The** International Women's Day topic **corresponds to the primary theme of the 66th Commission on the Status of Women (CSW66).
